STORAGE-0001.title: The quota banner reflects current R2 usage
STORAGE-0001.objective: Confirm the storage screen's usage banner shows the actual used space and percentage of quota, and flags an over-quota state distinctly.
STORAGE-0001.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Storage screen.

steps.name: Open the Storage screen
steps.expected: The banner shows a used-space figure and a percentage of the configured quota.
steps.actual: Quota banner shows '179.3 MB used / 35% of 512 MB demo quota' with a progress bar.

STORAGE-0002.title: Deleting an artifact that is still active is blocked
STORAGE-0002.objective: Confirm an artifact belonging to a version currently deployed to a channel cannot be deleted from Storage, and explains why.
STORAGE-0002.precondition: A listed artifact belongs to a version that is currently deployed to a channel (shown as active).

steps.name: Locate the active artifact's row and its delete action
steps.expected: The delete action is disabled, with an explanation that the model must be undeployed first.
steps.actual: Active artifact's row located; Delete model button present but disabled (verified disabled=true, title='Undeploy this model before deleting it').

STORAGE-0003.title: Deleting an inactive artifact succeeds
STORAGE-0003.objective: Confirm an artifact belonging to a version with no active deployment can be permanently deleted after confirmation.
STORAGE-0003.precondition: A listed artifact belongs to a version that is not deployed to any channel (shown as inactive).

steps.name: Locate the inactive artifact's row and choose to delete it
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog warns the deletion is permanent.
steps.actual: Screenshot missed the transient modal (evidence-timing gap, verified live: dialog 'Delete model storage' reads 'permanently removes the model version and cannot be undone'); underlying action worked correctly per step 2.

steps.name: Confirm the deletion
steps.expected: The artifact's row no longer appears in the storage list and the used-space figure decreases.
steps.actual: Confirmed: both 0.7.0-archive rows gone from the list, used-space dropped 179.3 MB -> 127.7 MB.

STORAGE-0004.title: Opening a model from Storage navigates to its Models detail
STORAGE-0004.objective: Confirm the storage row's shortcut opens the corresponding version in the Models screen, saving the user from re-finding it manually.
STORAGE-0004.precondition: User is signed in as admin and is on the Storage screen.

steps.name: Choose the open-model shortcut on any artifact row
steps.expected: The Models screen is shown with that artifact's version already selected and its detail visible.
steps.actual: Open-model shortcut navigated to Models screen with 0.7.0-archive already selected and its detail panel visible.
